data.text: I’ll commit to 15 tons this harvest and donate the full $15,000 to the clinic. My family taught me to protect both this lake and the neighbors who depend on it. Given this verified emergency, I’ll accept the one-month exception—and commit to no more than 6 tons next month, then 10 tons each once the stock returns to 100. We need everyone’s agreement so the recovery holds. John, will you join Jack and me in the donation and recovery commitments?
